about.heading: First-year CS (AI/ML), shipping in public.

short: I am a 1st-year Computer Science (AI/ML) undergraduate based in Pune, building practical AI workflows, CLI tools, and full-stack web apps.
medium: I am a 1st-year Computer Science (AI/ML) undergraduate based in Pune. Instead of keeping coursework in private folders, I build and ship public tools on GitHub—ranging from hackathon code generators like HackStack to terminal CLIs and Python game engines.
I am currently seeking summer internships, open-source mentorships (GSoC), and collaborative hackathon teams where I can own end-to-end features.
detailed: I am a 1st-year Computer Science (AI/ML) undergraduate based in Pune, India. My focus sits at the intersection of applied AI developer tooling, clean TypeScript web architecture, and foundational systems logic.

Over the past year I built HackStack to eliminate boilerplate for student hackathon teams, shipped slate_vision-cli, Snugg, and ToKens (WordCanvas3D) as live Vercel deployments, contributed a 3-pane workstation dashboard PR to Blue10.1, and wrote classic arcade loops in Python without game-engine abstractions.
Rather than listing self-rated skill bars, the language distribution beside this bio is computed directly from the byte counts across my visible public GitHub repositories.
